steps.title: Prepare HBSS/HEPES buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 495 mL HBSS with 5 mL 10 mM HEPES to a final volume of 500 mL; store at 4 °C for up to six months.

steps.title: Prepare 2% agarose solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g low‑gelling temperature agarose in 50 mL of the HBSS/HEPES buffer; keep the solution warm in an ice‑box with lukewarm water until use.

steps.title: Prepare serum‑free DMEM (SF‑DMEM)
steps.instruction: Combine 495 mL DMEM‑Glutamax with 5 mL penicillin‑streptomycin (100 U/mL) to a total of 500 mL; store at 4 °C for up to six months.

steps.title: Prepare imaging medium
steps.instruction: Mix 49 mL phenol‑red‑free DMEM, 500 µL penicillin‑streptomycin (100 U/mL) and 500 µL ProLong™ live antifade reagent (1 % v/v) to a final volume of 50 mL; use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare MTT working solution
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL MTT solution (10 % v/v) to 2.7 mL SF‑DMEM; use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare 70% methanol
steps.instruction: Mix 14 mL methanol with 6 mL distilled water to a final volume of 20 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Mix 14 mL absolute ethanol with 6 mL distilled water to a final volume of 20 mL; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare RLT/β‑mercaptoethanol buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 1,980 µL RLT buffer with 20 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (1 % v/v) to a total of 2 mL; use freshly.

steps.title: Dissect and inflate mouse lungs
steps.instruction: Perform mouse dissection and lung inflation as described in Procedure A1 (see Video 1 and Figure 1).

steps.title: Cool chilling block and mount blade
steps.instruction: Place the compresstome chilling block in a –20 °C freezer for 1 h; attach the stainless‑steel blade to its holder with a drop of super glue, hold with a paper clip and air‑dry 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Pre‑chill plates and disinfect tools
steps.instruction: Prepare a 48‑well plate with 300 µL ice‑cold SF‑DMEM per well and keep on ice; wipe the compresstome’s surgical tools, spatula, specimen holder and buffer tray with 70 % ethanol and let air‑dry.

steps.title: Embed lung lobe in agarose
steps.instruction: In a 90 mm petri dish, separate lung lobes, trim a tiny basal section to create a flat surface; place a tiny drop of super glue on the base of a specimen tube, position the lobe vertically onto the glue with forceps and cure 1 min; pull the plunger down to cover the tissue, then pipette lukewarm 2 % agarose to fully cover the lobe without bubbles; solidify on the chilled block for 1 min.

steps.title: Mount specimen tube in compresstome
steps.instruction: Insert the solidified specimen tube into the buffer tray until the stopper ring contacts the adapter; lower the micrometer until it touches the back of the tube; secure the blade holder on the axial bar with an Allen key; fill the tray with ice‑cold HBSS/HEPES until the tube is fully submerged.

steps.title: Precision‑cut lung slices
steps.instruction: Set the compresstome to start at 300 µm thickness, advance speed 4, oscillation 4; slice continuously, reducing thickness by 10 µm after each slice (300 → 290 → 280 → 270 → 260 → 250 µm); continue at 250 µm until the embedded tissue is completely sliced; collect each slice with a metal spatula into the pre‑chilled 48‑well plate (300 µL SF‑DMEM per well, one slice per well).

steps.title: Incubate and wash PCLS
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 2 h; then wash each well with 300 µL pre‑warmed SF‑DMEM, incubate 5 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; repeat the wash three times. (Optional pause: slices may be stored overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ before washing.)

steps.title: TAT‑Cre recombinase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL per well of pre‑warmed SF‑DMEM containing 3 µM TAT‑Cre to both R26R‑EYFP and wild‑type slices; incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Remove the solution, add 250 µL fresh SF‑DMEM and incubate a further 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Include negative controls: R26R‑EYFP slices with SF‑DMEM only and wild‑type slices with SF‑DMEM only.

steps.title: Immunostain PCLS with antibodies
steps.instruction: Dilute antibodies in pre‑warmed SF‑DMEM to the following concentrations: LAMP3 1:250, PDPN 1:500, PECAM 1:200, CD11c 1:200, TiY vimentin 1:2000. Add 250 µL per slice and incubate 2 h at 37 °C in the dark. For isotype controls, use Armenian hamster IgG‑PE 1:200 (for TiY) or rat IgG‑Alexa 647 1:200 (for the other antibodies) under the same conditions. After incubation, discard medium and add 250 µL DAPI (1 mg/mL, diluted 1:500 in SF‑DMEM); incubate 15 min at 37 °C in the dark. Wash three times with 300 µL pre‑warmed PBS, then proceed immediately to imaging.

steps.title: Set up live imaging of PCLS
steps.instruction: Pre‑equilibrate the microscope incubator chamber at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and ~21 % O₂ for 30 min. Add 100 µL pre‑warmed imaging medium to each well of an Ibidi 24‑well µ‑plate. Transfer each stained slice from the 48‑well plate onto the imaging medium with a metal spatula. Place a 12 mm Millicell® cell culture insert (0.4 µm pores) over the slice and secure with a flat metal washer. Add 200 µL imaging medium to the lower chamber and 400 µL to the upper chamber; cover the plate. Place the plate on the motorised stage and image using a 10× air objective for overview (405 nm DAPI, 514 nm EYFP) or a 40× oil objective for co‑localisation (561 nm vimentin, 633 nm LAMP3/PDPN/PECAM/CD11c).

steps.title: Perform MTT viability assay
steps.instruction: At 72 h post‑Cre, add 250 µL of 10 % MTT solution to each slice in a 48‑well plate. For a dead‑cell control, add 250 µL 70 % methanol to a separate slice and incubate 15 min at room temperature, then wash three times with 300 µL room‑temperature PBS. Incubate the MTT‑treated slices 45 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in the dark. Remove MTT solution and add 250 µL DMSO; incubate 10 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ in the dark. Pipette gently, transfer 200 µL from each well to a clear‑bottom 96‑well plate and read absorbance at 570 nm and 690 nm. Use four mice per genotype, three slices per treatment, and three technical replicates.

steps.title: Homogenise PCLS and extract RNA
steps.instruction: Clean the work surface with RNase Zap. Add homogenisation beads to the bottom of each 2 mL screw‑cap tube and label. Add 600 µL RLT/β‑ME lysis buffer to each tube. Wash each slice twice with 300 µL room‑temperature PBS, then transfer three slices of the same treatment into a tube (pool three slices per tube). Homogenise on a FastPrep‑24 for 45 s, rest 1 min, repeat 45 s. Centrifuge 13,000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C; transfer ~600 µL supernatant to a new tube, add 600 µL 70 % ethanol, mix. Load 600 µL onto an RNeasy spin column, centrifuge 13,000 × g for 1 min at RT, discard flow‑through; repeat with the remaining 600 µL. Wash column with 350 µL RW1 buffer, centrifuge 1 min RT, discard flow‑through. Prepare DNase I mix (10 µL DNase I stock + 70 µL RDD buffer); add 80 µL to the column, incubate 15 min RT. Wash with 350 µL RW1, centrifuge 1 min RT. Wash twice with 500 µL RPE buffer (first 1 min, second 2 min). Spin column in a new collection tube 1 min RT to remove residual buffer. Elute RNA with 30 µL RNase‑free water, centrifuge 1 min; repeat elution for higher yield. Store RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality with TapeStation
steps.instruction: Equilibrate RNA ScreenTape sample buffer at room temperature for 30 min and vortex. Thaw RNA on ice, mix 5 µL sample buffer with 1 µL RNA, vortex 1 min at 2,000 rpm, spin down. Denature at 72 °C for 3 min, cool on ice 2 min, spin. Load samples and loading tips into the 2200 TapeStation and run. Accept only samples with RNA integrity number (RIN) > 8 for downstream use.

steps.title: Reverse transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Thaw the High‑capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit on ice. For each 20 µL reaction, combine: 2 µL 10× RT buffer, 0.8 µL 25× dNTP mix (100 mM), 2 µL 10× RT random primers, 1 µL MultiScribe™ RT, RNA (200 ng), and nuclease‑free water to 20 µL. Mix, spin down, and run the thermal cycler: 25 °C 10 min, 37 °C 2 h, 85 °C 5 min, hold at 4 °C. Store cDNA at –20 °C.

steps.title: Run quantitative real‑time PCR
steps.instruction: Thaw cDNA, measure concentration and dilute to 50 ng/µL. Thaw TaqMan® assays for YFP (Mr04097229_mr) and B2m (Mm00437762_m1). Prepare per‑well reaction mix (total 10 µL): 5 µL 2× TaqMan® Fast Advanced Master Mix, 0.5 µL 20× TaqMan® gene expression assay, 2 µL cDNA (50 ng/µL), 2.5 µL nuclease‑free water. Set up triplicate reactions for each gene. Vortex briefly, spin, pipette 10 µL into a 96‑well PCR plate, seal with optical adhesive film, spin to remove bubbles. Run on a StepOne Plus system: UNG 50 °C 2 min, polymerase activation 95 °C 20 s, then 40 cycles of 95 °C 1 s and 60 °C 20 s. Analyze data using the 2⁻ΔΔCT method. Use four mice per genotype, pool three slices per RNA sample, and three RNA samples per treatment.
